## Type
- [ ] Feature/task
- [ ] Bug
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test/security
- [ ] Infrastructure

## Objective / problem
What needs to be done, and why?

## Scope
Describe the smallest useful change. Link relevant docs or API contract.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The requested change is implemented.
- [ ] The change has been tested and verified.
## Dependencies and risks
List required tasks, packages, services, or decisions. Mention possible blockers or risks. Write "None known" if there are no known dependencies or risks.

## Evidence / test plan
Explain how the task will be verified. Include test steps, expected results, screenshots, logs, or other evidence where applicable. If testing is not applicable, explain why.
